intro.title: Read: The Drawbridge
intro.say: Meg and Sam need to get into the castle. Listen to the story, and read along. Tap Start.

pages.text: Meg and Sam got to the castle. The drawbridge was shut.
“Let us in!” said Meg. Sam got his horn.
The king got up from his nap. “What is that?” he said.
The king got the big key. Thud, down went the drawbridge!
Meg and Sam ran in with a chest for the king.
In the chest was a chick! “Thank you!” said the king.

words.mean: A horn makes a loud sound when you blow it. Toot!
A chest is a big box with a lid.
A chick is a baby hen.

questions.q: Why did Sam get his horn?
